nodes.name: Workflow 1: Reverse Demand & Collective Supply Pooling (கூட்டு விற்பனை)
nodes.description: Buyer posts 500kg demand -> MatchingService scores candidate farmers -> Collective pool auto-assembled -> Buyer confirms -> CollectiveSellingService creates order & locks escrow -> Farmers notified

nodes.name: Workflow 2: Freshness Decay, Urgent Sale & Auto-Expiration
nodes.description: Farmer lists batch -> FreshnessService computes hourly decay -> At 4h enters URGENT SALE (15% discount) -> WhatsApp alert broadcast to B2B buyers -> At 0h marks EXPIRED and deactivates listing

nodes.name: Workflow 3: Direct Cart Purchase & Escrow Authorization (Mode 1)
nodes.description: Buyer browses marketplace -> Adds batches to cart -> Opens CartDrawer -> Clicks Checkout -> Authorizes escrow payment -> Order created -> Quantities deducted -> Farmers notified

nodes.name: Workflow 4: Low-Literacy Farmer Assisted Voice Harvest Listing
nodes.description: Farmer or Coordinator opens VoiceListingModal -> Speaks harvest details in Tamil/English -> Web Speech API extracts crop, qty, price -> Preview confirmed -> ProduceBatch created with unique batchCode

nodes.name: Workflow 5: 10-Stage Order Fulfillment & Quality Verification
nodes.description: ORDERED -> ACCEPTED -> PICKUP_SCHEDULED -> COLLECTED -> QUALITY_CHECKED (hub inspection) -> PACKED -> DISPATCHED -> DELIVERED (GPS updates) -> PAYMENT_RELEASED (auto escrow payout to farmers) -> COMPLETED

nodes.name: Workflow 6: Direct Price Negotiation & Counter-Offers
nodes.description: Buyer submits offer on farmer batch -> Farmer receives notification -> Farmer accepts (locks stock) OR counters with new price -> Buyer receives counter-offer -> Agreement leads to order

nodes.name: Workflow 7: Quality Dispute Arbitration & Resolution
nodes.description: Buyer or Farmer raises dispute with reason & evidence -> Admin views dispute dashboard -> Examines weighing logs & photos -> Updates status to RESOLVED with notes -> Adjusts escrow payout
